task.description:
Execute the Stage 1 test suite and produce a structured test report.

## What to run

1. `zig build test` — run all unit tests (including the new db_test and event_store_test stubs). Record: pass count, skip count, fail count.
2. `zig build test-engine` — run engine tests. Record result.
3. `zig build test-integration` — attempt integration tests.
   - If `BPM_TEST_DB_URL` is not set, document as SKIPPED with reason 'no DB URL'
   - If set, run and record all results.

## Report format
Write the test report to `tests/reports/WF02-stage1-20260520-run-01.md` following the format in the test developer guide §8. The report must include:
- Run date/time
- Commands run with exit codes
- Per-test-suite summary table (test name | result | req IDs covered)
- List of SKIPPED tests with reason
- List of FAILED tests with error output
- Overall verdict: PASS (all tests pass or skip — no fails), FAIL (any test fails)

## Acceptance criteria
- `zig build test` exits 0
- `zig build test-engine` exits 0
- Report written to tests/reports/WF02-stage1-20260520-run-01.md
- No failed (as opposed to skipped) tests
- result.status = PASS if no failures; FAIL if any test actually fails (not skips)
acceptance_criteria: No test failures (skips are acceptable — stubs are expected to skip)
